summary:
Docker Engine daemon (dockerd) AuthZ plugin bypass via oversized request
bodies. The only github.com/docker/docker package linked into any
datadog-agent binary is pkg/system (xattr helpers, in bin/agent/agent);
no daemon or AuthZ middleware code is compiled in. The fix ships only as
github.com/moby/moby v29; the docker/docker module path has no fixed
release. Upstream's go.mod also replaces docker/docker with the 28.x
branch head 31a1689cb0a1, which carries the pkg/authz body-limit backport.
